Eligibility for Availing Start-up Benefits: Benefits admissible to eligible Start-ups under applicable Government of India policies, incl uding exemption from EMD and relaxation in prior Turnover (wherever specifically permitte d under this Bid), shall be avail able only to bidders recognized as Start-ups by the Department for Promotion of Industry a nd Internal Trade (DPIIT) and holding a valid and subsisting Start-up Recognition Certificate as on the Bid due date. Such Start-up recognition must cover business activities/category directly relevant and simi lar to the subject matter of this Bid. For this tender, the eligible activities/category shall incl ude hiring, leasing, rental, fleet operations, transport services, or similar services relating to passenger vehicles. The bidder shall further ensure and certify that its turnover in any financial year has not ex ceeded the limits prescribed under the applicable DPIIT Start-up recognition norms / certific ate / Start-up scheme, and that it continues to remain eligible as a Start-up on the Bid due date. Bidders recognized as Start-ups only for unrelated activities / categories, or those functioni ng merely as Traders, dealers, resellers, commission agents, intermediaries, or aggregator s without relevant operational capability, or those exceeding the prescribed eligibility limits , shall not be eligible to claim Start-up benefits under this tender.

The bidder shall submit documentary evidence in support of Start-up recognition, relevant business activity/category, and continued eligibility status. The decision of AIASL regarding eligibility , relevance of activity/category, and admissibility of benefits shall be final and bin ding. 7. Bidder shall submit undertaking for acceptance of Bid Terms and Conditions including Bu yer added ATC Clauses. OR Duly Signed and Stamped GeM Bid document may be submitted, which shall be considered as an acceptance of all Bid Terms and Conditions including ATC. . . 5.
